mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_authorization_permission ( code, action, resource_type, risk_tier, audit_level, system_only, agent_delegable, source_module, definition_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{row.code}, #{row.action}, #{row.resourceType}, #{row.riskTier}, #{row.auditLevel}, #{row.systemOnly}, #{row.agentDelegable}, #{row.sourceModule}, #{row.definitionVersion}, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET action = EXCLUDED.action, resource_type = EXCLUDED.resource_type, risk_tier = EXCLUDED.risk_tier, audit_level = EXCLUDED.audit_level, system_only = EXCLUDED.system_only, agent_delegable = EXCLUDED.agent_delegable, source_module = EXCLUDED.source_module, definition_version = ainer_authorization_permission.definition_version + 1, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT code, action, resource_type, risk_tier, audit_level, system_only, agent_delegable, source_module, definition_version, created_at, updated_at FROM ainer_authorization_permission ORDER BY code
